title: Departure go / hold / no-go
description: Assess conditions against criteria declared before the decision point, then go, hold and reassess within a bounded limit, or take the pre-planned alternative.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-flt-03
  title: Departure go / hold / no-go
  description: Assess conditions against criteria declared before the decision point, then go, hold and
    reassess within a bounded limit, or take the pre-planned alternative.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reach a departure decision against criteria set in advance, where no-go is a planned outcome
    with its own path rather than a failure to be argued out of.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Current conditions and declared criteria
      summary: Current conditions and declared criteria
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - current_conditions
              - declared_go_criteria
              - slot_and_curfew
              - contingency_options
            properties:
              current_conditions: {}
              declared_go_criteria: {}
              slot_and_curfew: {}
              contingency_options: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-assess
      kind: agent
      templateRef: flt-03
      name: Assess conditions against the declared criteria
      summary: Assess current conditions against the criteria declared before the decision point.
      role: Forecaster translating aviation weather products into operational limits for a specific flight.
      prompt: You are an Aviation Meteorologist. You read TAFs, METARs, SIGMETs, and convective and icing
        products against the route, the aircraft's capability, and the alternate minima that apply, and
        you state the timing and confidence of every deterioration you forecast. You distinguish a forecast
        from an observation, and you say when the forecast period does not cover the arrival window rather
        than extrapolating over the gap.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - teaching
          - decision-analysis
          - simulation
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:weather
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-criteria
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score against the declared criteria
      summary: Evaluate destination and alternate minima, performance margin, and airspace availability
        at the planned departure time.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against destination and alternate minima, performance margin,
        and airspace availability at the planned departure time. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the
        evidence behind the verdict, remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not
        claim programmatic measurement unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.9
    - id: n-decision
      kind: condition
      name: Go, hold, or no-go
      summary: Three declared outcomes. No-go is a planned outcome with its own path, not a failure.
      config:
        expression: conditions.assessment selects one declared branch against the pre-declared go criteria
        branches:
          - label: Go
            when: go
          - label: Hold
            when: hold
          - label: No-go
            when: no-go
          - label: Default
            when: default
    - id: n-proceed
      kind: agent
      templateRef: flt-01
      name: Execute the departure plan
      summary: Execute against the approved plan.
      role: Licensed dispatcher holding joint responsibility with the captain for the safe conduct of
        a flight.
      prompt: You are a Flight Dispatcher. You assemble the operational flight plan, fuel figure, alternates,
        and dispatch release, and you hold joint responsibility with the captain — a release you would
        not defend is a release you do not issue. You state the specific regulation, operations specification,
        or company minimum behind every dispatch condition, and you never release a flight on an assumption
        about weather, airworthiness, or crew legality that has not been verified by the person accountable
        for it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - release-engineering
          - evidence-verification
          - compliance-review
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:flight-planning
          - mcp:ops-control
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-hold
      kind: loop
      name: Hold and reassess within the declared limit
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until conditions clear the declared criteria, or the
        crew duty and slot limits are reached.
      config:
        body:
          - n-assess
          - n-criteria
          - n-decision
        exitCondition: conditions clear the declared criteria, or the crew duty and slot limits are reached
        maxIterations: 3
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-contingency
      kind: agent
      templateRef: flt-06
      name: Take the pre-planned alternative
      summary: The pre-planned alternative, chosen because it was planned before it was needed.
      role: Rostering specialist testing crew duty limits and fatigue risk for the planned operation.
      prompt: You are a Crew Legality & Fatigue Analyst. You test the planned duty against flight and
        duty period limits, rest requirements, augmentation, and the qualifications each crew member actually
        holds for this aircraft, airport, and operation. You assess fatigue risk separately from legality,
        because a duty can be legal and still be the highest-risk element of the flight, and you say so
        plainly rather than resolving it as a scheduling detail.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - contract-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - teaching
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:crew-management
        permissions:
          - read-only
          - pii-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Duty operations manager records the decision and its basis
      summary: Pause for the duty operations manager; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Departure go / hold / no-go deliverable, the evidence behind it, and
        every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-flt-03-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-assess
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-03-edge-2
      from: n-assess
      to: n-criteria
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-03-edge-3
      from: n-criteria
      to: n-decision
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-03-edge-4
      from: n-decision
      to: n-proceed
      kind: control
      condition: go
    - id: wf-flt-03-edge-5
      from: n-decision
      to: n-hold
      kind: control
      condition: hold
    - id: wf-flt-03-edge-6
      from: n-decision
      to: n-contingency
      kind: control
      condition: no-go
    - id: wf-flt-03-edge-7
      from: n-proceed
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-03-edge-8
      from: n-hold
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-flt-03-edge-9
      from: n-contingency
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-03-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
